baseline_scope: The baseline reports retain their original hashes. WEB/GIF/PNG/JPG are byte-identical. The resident payload differs only in the relocated mono_http_error call target and NET-size bytes; final NET and gateway paths have focused final-binary tests.
standalone_source_test: http-redirect-mobile.json executes a separately linked 6502 fixture compiled from final HTTP/mobile/net sources, with 16 cases.
native_tls_evidence: archive28-baseline.json and archive29-validation.json use native firmware MbedTLS with the unchanged certificate profile; embedded29 and PEM29 verify archive.org with zero flags, old PEM28 still fails, and wrong hostname is rejected. They are not physical-board tests.
